title: Biomarkers in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy.
authors: Salort-Campana, Emmanuelle; Bendahan, David; Magdinier, Frederique; Attarian, Shahram
one_liner_zh: 该文综述面肩肱型肌营养不良症的生物标志物，涉及DUX4转录靶点与AI辅助分层，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy is one of the most frequent myopathies. Its clinical presentation and genetic background are unique. FSHD needs reliable and measurable biomarkers to monitor the disease and assess the efficacy of therapeutic approaches. The purpose of this review is to summarize and focus on the most recent evidence regarding the different available biomarkers at the level of muscle imaging, circulating molecules and muscle-based markers that currently are the main potential candidates in FSHD. RECENT FINDINGS: A large phase III trial testing losmapimod (a small molecule inhibitor of p38alpha MAPK, which regulates DUX4 expression) in FSHD patients failed to demonstrate clear clinical benefits, highlighting concerns about trial readiness. KHDC1L, a recently identified direct transcriptional target of DUX4, is a candidate circulating protein biomarker directly associated with DUX4 activity, although independent replication and analytical validation are still awaited. Quantitative muscle MRI and, increasingly, quantitative muscle ultrasound provide complementary imaging biomarkers that are now being compared head-to-head. Artificial intelligence-based tools are increasingly being used to capture disease heterogeneity and support patient stratification. SUMMARY: Facing the genetic and phenotypic complexity of FSHD, robust biomarkers must be used to assess the efficacy of the experimental treatments, and individuals must be selected and stratified to minimize variability, in order to prepare for future clinical trials.
abstract_zh: 综述目的：面肩肱型肌营养不良症（Facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy）是最常见的肌病之一，其临床表现和遗传背景具有独特性。FSHD需要可靠且可测量的生物标志物来监测疾病并评估治疗方法的疗效。本综述旨在总结并聚焦于肌肉影像学、循环分子及肌肉来源标志物等不同层面现有生物标志物的最新证据，这些是目前FSHD中主要的潜在候选标志物。近期发现：一项针对FSHD患者的大规模III期试验测试了losmapimod（一种调控DUX4表达的p38alpha MAPK小分子抑制剂），但未能显示出明确的临床获益，凸显了试验准备方面的担忧。KHDC1L，作为最近发现的DUX4直接转录靶标，是一种候选循环蛋白生物标志物，与DUX4活性直接相关，尽管独立复制和分析验证仍有待进行。定量肌肉MRI及日益增多的定量肌肉超声提供了互补的影像学生物标志物，目前正进行头对头比较。基于人工智能的工具正越来越多地用于捕捉疾病异质性并支持患者分层。总结：面对FSHD的遗传和表型复杂性，必须使用稳健的生物标志物来评估实验性治疗的疗效，并需选择和分层个体以减少变异性，为未来临床试验做好准备。
